sdk.windows_distribution: source-build; official 0.10.0 Windows ZIP does not include Vulkan

sdk_recomp.why: NativeXRenderer needs this branch: REX_HOOK_RAW hooks, the SDK's draw observer and the shared graphics fixes are listed one commit at a time in its RECOMP.md. The official v0.10.0 release does not carry them.

native_x_renderer.license: MIT; DiligentCore, DLSS, SMAA and the SDK parts keep their own (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md there)

submodules_of_its_own.thirdparty/diligent-core: fetch with git submodule update --init --recursive inside it; its CMake applies diligent_patches/

native_x_renderer.why: a native renderer for ReXGlue games: it hooks the game's XDK D3D entry points and draws them on DiligentCore/Vulkan instead of emulating Xenos' command stream, EDRAM and resolves

generated_candidate.compatibility_with_official_sdk: unverified; modified SDK used by the source project
